# read_blob { #labdata.gitutil.read_blob }

```python
labdata.gitutil.read_blob(repo, blob_sha)
```

Read the content of a blob into memory.

Only for content known to be small, such as a Git LFS pointer. Use
[](`labdata.gitutil.write_blob_to`) for result files, which can be hundreds
of megabytes.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**repo**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Union](`typing.Union`)\[[Location](`labdata.location.Location`), [Path](`pathlib.Path`), [str](`str`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Working tree holding the blob, on this machine or another.

<code>[**blob_sha**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Blob sha to read.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bytes](`bytes`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The raw content of the blob.
